items.how: Licence; registers of workers; annual return.
items.ref: Factories Act 1948 / OSH Code 2020 (as in force)
steps: Check validity, workers and power covered
items.text: Factory licence held and renewed; licence covers the number of workers and power installed.

steps: Obtain inspection certificates (lifts, hoists, pressure vessels)
items.text: Safety and health compliance: inspection certificates of lifts, hoists, pressure vessels; accident register.

items.how: CTE / CTO with validity and conditions.
items.ref: Water Act 1974 s.25; Air Act 1981 s.21
steps: Obtain CTE / CTO from the SPCB
items.text: Consent to Establish and Consent to Operate from the State Pollution Control Board valid for the year.

items.ref: Environment (Protection) Act 1986; Hazardous and Other Wastes Rules 2016
items.text: Authorisation for hazardous waste held; annual return filed.

items.how: CPCB EPR portal registration and certificates.
items.ref: Plastic Waste Management Rules 2016; E-Waste Rules 2022
steps: Check whether the entity is a producer / importer / brand owner
items.text: Extended producer responsibility registration and targets met where the entity is a producer, importer or brand owner.

steps: List products covered by Quality Control Orders
items.text: Products covered by a Quality Control Order carry a valid BIS licence.
Packer / importer registration held; label declarations (MRP, net quantity, date) correct.
Boilers registered and inspection certificates valid.
